prompt.zh: 生成一张高端室内设计杂志风格的方形照片，同时准确融合四张参考图。将参考图1中造型和红色材质一致的椅子放在浅灰色微水泥墙前；在椅子右侧放置一张小型圆形橡木边桌，并将参考图2中具有相同轮廓、蓝色纹样和陶瓷质感的花瓶置于桌面中央；把参考图3中的金属落地灯放在椅子左后方；在地面铺设一张矩形地毯，其几何纹样和红、黑、米白配色严格取自参考图4。四个参考元素必须彼此独立、无遮挡、比例合理，使用从左侧窗户射入的柔和晨光和一致的接触阴影。画面中只能有一把椅子、一张边桌、一个花瓶、一盏落地灯和一张地毯，不要添加鲜花、书籍或其他装饰。
prompt.en: Generate a square high-end interior-design magazine photograph that accurately combines all four references. Place a chair matching the shape and red material of reference 1 in front of a light-gray microcement wall. Put a small round oak side table to the chair's right, with the vase from reference 2 centered on it, preserving its silhouette, blue pattern and ceramic finish. Position the metal floor lamp from reference 3 behind and to the left of the chair. Cover the floor with one rectangular rug whose geometric motifs and red, black and warm-white palette come strictly from reference 4. Keep all referenced elements separate, unobstructed and realistically scaled, with soft morning light from a left window and consistent contact shadows. Show only one chair, one side table, one vase, one floor lamp and one rug; add no flowers, books or other decoration.
